name: SearchUs – Site Search for WordPress and WooCommerce
author: funnelwon

sections.description:
Replace WordPress’s default search with a powerful site search plugin for WordPress and WooCommerce. SearchUs helps visitors quickly find pages, posts, WooCommerce products, images, videos, PDFs, documents, audio, and other media with fast, relevance-ranked results.

SearchUs delivers a better search experience with Predictive Search as visitors type, customizable results, search intent, synonyms, Smart 404 recovery, and flexible search pages. WooCommerce shoppers can filter products, select variations, and buy from search results—helping them find what they need faster with fewer clicks.

Key Features

Predictive Search (live AJAX search as you type)
Results and word suggestions load live in a dropdown as visitors type, without reloading the page—in your theme’s header search, search icons, Search Embeds, and on the results page. Results are grouped into All, Images, and Shopping tabs; products show their image, price, and an Add to Cart or Buy Now button so shoppers can buy without leaving the page. Word suggestions come from your own index and can include popular searches from other visitors, with your own blocked words and a built-in offensive-word filter. A whole typing session counts as one search, suggesting words never counts, and pressing Enter or “See all results” continues to the full results page without counting twice. On the results page itself, the results update in place when visitors pause after a finished word (no dropdown covering them; each update counts as one search, like pressing Enter), and every dropdown offers “Search for …” so visitors always see how to run what they typed. Works with the keyboard and screen readers, and is off until you turn it on under SERP → Predictive Search.

Better WordPress Search
Replace WordPress’s built-in search with fast, relevance-ranked site search across pages, posts, WooCommerce products, images, videos, PDFs, documents, audio, and other indexed content. Show results on a dedicated search page with tabs such as All, Products, Images, Videos, Documents, and Audio; choose list or grid layouts while keeping your site’s header and footer.

WooCommerce Search Built for Shopping
Turn product search into a shopping experience. Index your catalog, let customers filter by category, price, brand, color, size, and other attributes, and understand natural-language searches like “under $100.” Shoppers can select color, size, and other options on variable products and use Buy Now to cart or checkout without opening the product page first. Map shopper language (for example “XXL” or “sneakers”) to real variation options and intent synonyms so the right products rank and preselect. Optional AI Assist can draft those synonym and variation-alias maps for you.

Scoped Search Embeds
Place search boxes anywhere with a shortcode and choose exactly what visitors can search—products, pages, posts, images, videos, documents, audio, selected categories, or your entire site. Ideal for shop pages, landing pages, and page builders.

Search Analytics & Content Gaps
See what visitors are searching for—including queries that return zero results—so you can improve your site instead of guessing. Spot missing products or pages to create, decide which synonym maps to add, and focus ranking and content work where shoppers actually look. Analytics are on by default, stay on your WordPress site and can be turned off any time.

Search Intent & Synonyms
Understand what visitors mean—not just what they type. Built-in intent and synonym matching help connect searches like “lead gen” with content about “lead generation.”

“Did You Mean?” Suggestions
Reduce failed searches by suggesting better terms when no matching results are found.

Fully Customizable Search Ranking
Control how results are ranked by adjusting the importance of titles, headings, content, URLs, media, products, pages, posts, and more. Promote your most important content to the top of search results.

Automatic Search Indexing
Keep your search index up to date by automatically detecting content changes, crawling your sitemap, or performing a full site scan.

Promote Important Content
Feature announcements, products, promotions, or key pages by inserting promoted results into search results.

Secure & Reliable
Protect your search experience with settings locking, plan-tier rate protection, and automated bot filtering to reduce abusive or junk search traffic before it consumes your usage.

Built to Scale
Whether your site has dozens of pages or hundreds of thousands of products, SearchUs scales with your content while keeping WordPress search fast, organized, and easy to use.

Smart 404 Recovery
Recover visitors before they leave by replacing dead-end 404 pages with relevant pages, posts, products, or media based on the requested URL.

Options

Use the SearchUs search results page, or keep your theme’s default WordPress search template while benefiting from SearchUs indexing and relevance ranking.

Choose which post types, products, and media types to index. Configure layouts, ranking, excerpts, results per page, Buy Now destination, excluded URLs, excluded page sections, and more from one settings area.

Requires PHP 7.4 or later.

After license activation, SearchUs securely communicates with the FunnelWon service for indexing, search queries, licensing, and plan usage. Free plans include a “Site Search by SearchUs.io” attribution link where applicable. Paid plans can remove attribution based on license level. SearchUs does not include third-party advertising or behavioral tracking.

External services

This plugin connects to FunnelWon SearchUs (hosted API and account dashboard at https://searchus.io). Use of the service is subject to our Terms and Privacy (links below).

When data is sent

  • License activation / validation – When you enter or refresh an API key (and on periodic checks the plugin performs).
  • Indexing – When you run a full reindex, delta/index push, or auto-crawl sends content to build or update the remote index.
  • Visitor search – After activation, each real visitor search counts toward the monthly search allowance (unless blocked locally as junk; see below). The service ranks a search when this site does not already have that result saved. A repeat search can be answered from the saved result on the site and still counts.
  • Predictive Search (if turned on) – While a visitor types, the text typed so far is sent after a short pause to show preview results, with a random typing-session ID so the whole session counts as one search. The ID lives only in the open page (no cookie) and is not linked to the visitor. Word suggestions come from a word list the site downloads from the service after each index update; suggesting words sends nothing.
  • Usage and configuration – When the admin loads usage, reindex eligibility, or optional cloud settings backup/sync features you use.
  • Attribution check (free plans) – On free plans, the SearchUs service may load your site’s public search page to confirm the SearchUs attribution is shown.

What is sent (summary)

  • Site URL, API key, plugin version, site identifier, and technical headers needed for authentication and plan routing.
  • Content and metadata you enable for indexing (titles, body areas, headings, product fields, media alt text, filenames, etc.).
  • Visitor search query text, including text typed into Predictive Search (not used for third-party advertising).
  • Aggregated usage for quotas (e.g. query counts, indexed URL counts, reindex allowance).

What stays on your server

  • SearchUs analytics (on by default, can be turned off) is stored in your WordPress database only.
  • Query guard (core/query-guard.php) evaluates queries locally and does not send obvious bot/scanner probes to the API or third parties. Searches from crawlers, monitors and scripts (recognised by their user agent) are not sent or counted either.
  • A search result cache (transients) may store a recent result on the site for speed. A later search for the same text can use that saved result. It still counts as a visitor search. The cache is not shared with advertisers.

Legal

  • Terms of Service: https://searchus.io/tos/
  • Privacy Policy: https://searchus.io/privacy/

For more detail, see the Privacy section below and the in-plugin FAQ.

Privacy

Licensing and API

When the plugin contacts FunnelWon’s (SearchUs) services—for license validation, indexing, search results, or configuration sync—it may send your site URL, API key (if you have entered one), plugin version, and other technical data needed to operate the service. Your site URL is used among other things to apply your plan and allowed environments (for example production, staging, and development URLs permitted under your license). After you complete license activation, indexing sends the content and metadata described in the plugin and settings (e.g. pages, posts, products). Each visitor search counts toward the monthly search allowance. Query text is sent when the site does not already have that result saved; a repeat answered from the saved result still counts. Before activation, those flows are not used for front-end ?s= requests.

Support (information you choose to share)

If you contact support, we may ask you to share diagnostic details so we can reproduce issues and spot conflicts—for example your hosting provider or environment, active WordPress theme (name and version), and list of active plugins, often by pasting Tools → Site Health → Info from your admin. You decide what to send; we use it only to troubleshoot (including cache and plugin conflicts) and improve compatibility. Unless a future feature clearly discloses it and asks for consent, the plugin does not automatically upload your theme or full plugin list to us solely for support.

What the plugin sends automatically (no separate ad or marketing profile)

  • Site identity and licensing: your site URL (and any staging/dev URLs your license allows), API key if you enter one, plugin version, and related technical fields so we can validate the license, apply plan limits, and route API requests.
  • Indexing: text and metadata from the content types you enable (e.g. titles, excerpts, body areas, headings, product fields, image alt text, file names)—only what is needed to build and update the search index.
  • Search: each visitor search counts toward the plan’s monthly search allowance once license activation is complete. The service ranks the search when the site does not already have that result saved. A repeat can be answered from the saved result on the site and still counts. Until an API key is stored after activation, front-end ?s= search uses WordPress’s built-in search and is not sent to SearchUs. Queries are not used for third-party advertising.
  • In-plugin analytics (on by default, can be turned off in the Analytics tab): aggregated search and click counts stored on your WordPress site in its database. No cookies are used and nothing personal is stored. This data is not sent to FunnelWon; it stays on your server and is used for the Analytics tab and popular search suggestions (both can be turned off).

What we do not do

  • We do not sell your site URL, license details, index payloads, search queries, or support diagnostics to third parties for advertising or to build ad profiles.
  • The plugin does not load third-party advertising or behavioral-tracking scripts for FunnelWon’s benefit.
  • We do not automatically upload your theme name, plugin list, or Site Health dump—only what you choose to send if you contact support.

Personal data (PII) in plain language

SearchUs is not designed to collect visitor identities for marketing. However, search queries can contain anything a visitor types, and indexed content may include names, emails, or other data you published on the site—those flows are part of normal search and indexing, not a separate “PII harvesting” feature. If you are a data controller for your site’s visitors, you should describe SearchUs in your privacy policy (and comply with applicable law). FunnelWon’s own handling of data received through the service is described in our policies below.

Terms of Service and Privacy Policy

Use of the hosted SearchUs service is governed by our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy on the SearchSaaS dashboard site:

  • Terms of Service: https://searchus.io/tos/
  • Privacy Policy: https://searchus.io/privacy/

For retention, security, legal bases, subprocessors, and other details, see the Privacy Policy link above. That policy governs FunnelWon / SearchUs as the service provider; your site still needs its own policy where required. The Privacy Policy is also published at https://funnelwon.com/privacy/ for convenience.

Third-party libraries

The plugin bundles Driver.js (https://github.com/kamranahmedse/driver.js) under the MIT License for the in-admin setup walkthrough. Source is included under admin/vendor/driver/.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ (for example searchus/) or install via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin. Complete free or paid license activation in SearchUs settings (register or paste an API key). The plugin creates a Search page; after activation, search and indexing use the SearchUs API as described in Privacy and External services. Until activation, visitor ?s= search stays on WordPress’s built-in search.
  3. In the WordPress admin sidebar, open SearchUs – Site Search for WordPress and WooCommerce to lock settings, run a full reindex, and configure SERP, ranking, and Smart 404.
  4. Run “Full site reindex” at least once so the index is built. After that, optional auto-crawl can keep it updated.

Before the first successful reindex: With license activation complete and SearchUs handling visitor search (the default), searches are counted toward the monthly allowance and ranked by SearchUs when the site does not already have a saved result. If nothing has been indexed yet, visitors often see no results—the plugin does not switch back to WordPress’s built-in search in that mode. Run a full reindex as soon as setup allows. If you need core WordPress search until indexing finishes, choose Use default WordPress results page under SERP → Layout in settings.
sections.faq:
Do I need to reindex?

Yes. Run a full site reindex from the plugin admin (Plugin Settings → Reindex / crawl area) after activation and when you add or change a lot of content. Optional auto-crawl can then keep the index updated when you publish or update posts/pages.

After your license is activated, visitor search uses the SearchUs API (unless you chose “default WordPress results” under SERP → Layout). Until the first full reindex has completed, many sites will show empty search results—that is expected, not a fallback to WordPress’s native search. Complete a full reindex to populate the service index; use the default WordPress results option temporarily if you need the theme’s normal search while indexing is still running.

Can I use my theme’s search template?

Yes. Under SERP → Layout, choose “Use default WordPress results page.” After license activation, we still supply the results and ranking via the API; your theme controls the layout. Attribution may appear on the free tier per your license and API response.

What is Smart 404?

When a visitor hits a 404, the plugin can show “similar” results derived from the URL (e.g. missing product or page). Enable it under Smart 404s in settings.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Enable the product post type for indexing under Crawl → Inclusion. Product caps and ranking multipliers are under Ranking. On the SearchUs SERP template, Ecommerce → WooCommerce controls Buy Now destination (checkout, cart, or off). Simple in-stock products show Buy Now. Variable products show option pickers (color, size, and other attributes) and Buy Now for the selected in-stock variation. Grouped products link via the product title. External/affiliate products can show a vendor buy link. Buy Now requires published WooCommerce Cart and/or Checkout pages. Stock and price refresh when results load. The same screen holds Variant Option Aliases (YAML map like Intent synonyms) so query language such as “extra extra large” maps to your attribute term slugs for variation preselect.

What data is sent to SearchUs by FunnelWon?

See Privacy and External services. In short: your site URL, API key (if any), plugin version, and data required for indexing/search/API are transmitted after activation as part of the service. Theme, hosting, and plugin lists are not sent automatically for support—you may be asked to provide those manually if you open a ticket. Junk scanner queries are blocked locally and are not sent.

What are the minimum requirements?

  • WordPress 5.9 or higher (see header above for the “Tested up to” value).
  • PHP 7.4 or higher (see header above).
  • Outbound HTTPS connectivity from your server to FunnelWon’s SearchUs API for license activation, indexing, and visitor search once setup is complete.
  • A modern hosting stack; curl or equivalent is used via WordPress HTTP APIs.

MySQL/MariaDB versions follow WordPress core requirements for your WordPress version.

What does “Tested up to” mean?

The Tested up to value in the plugin header is the latest WordPress release the authors have smoke-tested with this plugin version. Use a current, supported WordPress version on your site.

Why do I need license activation for search and indexing?

SearchUs is a hosted search service: indexing and ranked results run against FunnelWon’s API after a free or paid API key is stored. Until you finish activation, front-end search requests use WordPress’s default search so visitors are not routed through SearchUs for ?s= results.

Is this plugin a fork of another search plugin?

No. SearchUs by FunnelWon is developed and maintained by FunnelWon. It is not a fork of any plugin or other third-party search plugins.

Do you offer paid plans? What changes when I upgrade?

This is one plugin with the same settings UI on every plan. Upgrading means a FunnelWon / SearchUs license with higher service quotas, for example:

  • More indexed URLs (index cap on the API).
  • Higher monthly search queries. On paid production sites, search keeps working past the monthly allowance: search credits are added automatically (up to a monthly limit per plan), and if credits are not being charged the SearchUs attribution shows until the month resets or you upgrade.
  • More frequent full reindexes when your plan allows (the service returns allowance and retry timing in usage/API responses—not hidden timers in the plugin).
  • Attribution removal on results while your paid site is within its allowance.

Ranking weights, intent, media extraction, SERP injections, reordering, and multi-user mode remain available in the plugin; the service applies your saved configuration when processing search and indexing. For plan comparison and pricing, see https://searchus.io/

Where can I find documentation?

Product and setup information are published on FunnelWon (see the Author link above). The in-plugin FAQ panel and settings descriptions explain individual controls. For WordPress.org installs, use the plugin’s support forum for general questions.

Will it work with my theme?

In most cases, yes. After license activation, the plugin adds a dedicated search page template and can redirect normal WordPress search (?s=) to it, or you can use default WordPress search results so your theme’s search template wraps our results (see SERP → Layout). You may need minor CSS adjustments so the search page matches your theme. Themes that heavily override search or use unusual routing should be tested after installation.

Where can I report bugs, request features, or get help?

  • WordPress.org users: use the plugin’s Support tab / forum on this listing.
  • License customers: use the support channel provided with your SearchUs by FunnelWon subscription (see https://searchus.io).

When reporting issues, include WordPress version, PHP version, active theme, and (if asked) a paste of Tools → Site Health → Info—see the Privacy section.
sections.changelog:
3.1.3

  • Improved: SearchUs displays consistently across more themes, on the results page and in Predictive Search.
  • Improved: If SearchUs search is unavailable due to lack of payment or not following the Terms of Service, visitors get WordPress’s built-in search instead of an error message.
  • Changed: Predictive Search counts up to 4 result previews within 30 seconds as one search, and going on to the results page isn’t counted again.

3.1.2

  • Improved: protection against bot and automated traffic adding to search usage and search credit charges.
  • Changed: predictive search counts up to 8 result previews within 60 seconds as one search.

3.1.1

  • Fixed: searching from the results page (Enter, “Search for …”, a suggested word, results per page, product filters) and from Search Embed boxes dropped any extra settings in your search page’s address (for example ?lang=fr), which could open the wrong page.

3.1.0

  • New: Update Results as You Type for the search box on your results page. When visitors pause after a finished word, the results refresh on the page without a reload and without a dropdown covering them. Each update counts as one search, the same as pressing Enter. This is now the default for the results page (SERP → Predictive Search → On the Results Page).
  • Sites set to Word Suggestions Only on the results page switch to Update Results as You Type once, and see a notice in the admin. To switch back, change SERP → Predictive Search → On the Results Page.
  • While results update as visitors type, the browser keeps one history entry per search session, so Back returns to the results they started from. Product filters reset when the search changes, as they do when pressing Enter. The Smart 404 recovery page keeps word suggestions only.
  • Every Predictive Search dropdown now starts with “Search for …”, so visitors always see how to run what they typed. It also replaces the “No results” message in result previews.
  • Phones: after a pause, the keyboard closes so results are visible: 1 second after a finished word, 2 seconds after a partial word or a delete, and 3 seconds after a space so visitors can keep typing. Pressing keys such as Shift counts as still typing. Tapping the search box brings the keyboard back; tapping a tab or a suggested word doesn’t. Tapping outside closes the dropdown.
  • Analytics now separates results-page searches visitors ran by pressing Enter from those that updated as they typed, with matching filters and summary cards.
  • Account sign-up in the plugin: if you already entered your code at searchus.io, a note under the code box explains how to copy your API key from searchus.io.
  • New: Activating on a public domain that isn’t connected to SearchUs yet now proves you control the site. The plugin publishes a short verification code that SearchUs checks automatically. Local and staging sites skip this, and sites already connected aren’t asked again. If the check fails, the plugin explains why; fix it and click Activate again, or upload the code as a plain-text file to /.well-known/searchus-verify.txt.
  • The account sign-up box is more compact, with “Or register at searchus.io” next to the Register button.
  • Predictive Search: searches are limited to 100 characters, and each visitor address can start up to 20 new result-preview sessions a minute (typing within a session doesn’t count). Past that, the dropdown shows “Predictive results are paused. Press Enter to search.” Pressing Enter still searches.
  • Fixed: “Exit Setup Forever” in the setup walkthrough didn’t stick while settings were locked.
  • Fixed: with Multi-User Mode off, another administrator’s earlier editing session could stop you from unlocking and editing settings.

3.0.0

  • New: Predictive Search. Suggestions and result previews appear while visitors type in your header and navigation search (including search icons and mobile menus) by default. Other search boxes on the page and each Search Embed can be set to Off, Word suggestions only, or Full, and the results-page box has its own setting. Turn it on under SERP → Predictive Search.
  • Word suggestions come from your own index, finish partly typed words, and never count as searches. Optional popular searches suggest what other visitors searched for.
  • Result previews show All, Images, and Shopping tabs. Products show image, price, and an Add to Cart or Buy Now button with its own destination setting. Shopping previews put products that match the color and size you typed ahead of partial matches.
  • “See all results” stays visible while the preview list scrolls, with a fade when more results are below.
  • A typing session counts as one search (up to 8 previews within 60 seconds; typing past that starts a new counted search). Continuing to the results page with Enter or “See all results” is not counted again.
  • Choose how many results and how many word suggestions appear, and what the results-page search box shows.
  • Blocked words and a built-in offensive-word filter keep unwanted suggestions out of the dropdown. Search results are never filtered.
  • Analytics shows Predictive Search sessions, dropdown click rate, and how many sessions went on to the results page.
  • Works with the keyboard and screen readers; buttons are sized for phones.
  • Searches from crawlers, monitors and scripts are no longer sent to the service or counted, and searches made only of very common words (such as “and” or “the”) are not counted.
  • Free plans can now tune ranking: page, post, product and media multipliers, the homepage boost, and intent settings all apply on every plan.
  • On free plans that are over the monthly search allowance, the Predictive Search credit appears above the search box instead of at the bottom of the dropdown.
  • External and affiliate products show their own buy button, using the button text you set.
  • Unpublishing, making private, trashing, or deleting an item removes it from search right away, including searches visitors already made.
  • Republishing an unpublished item puts it back in search immediately, even when the content did not change.
  • Background indexing finishes while Settings Lock is on.
  • Pages stay in the crawl queue, marked “Sent – waiting for confirmation”, until the service confirms they are indexed.
  • New or republished pages show up in searches that were already cached.
  • Reordering and injection rules apply when the search contains every word of the rule (synonyms count). When several rules match, the one matching the most words wins.
  • A full reindex keeps running in the background after you leave the settings page, then refreshes cached searches.
  • New: All Tab Results under SERP → Layout. Choose which types appear in the All tab (pages, posts, products, images, PDFs, documents, videos, audio) and the most of each type it shows.
  • The All tab can mix results by relevance (Display by score) or show one block per type in an order you drag or set with the arrow buttons (Display by group).
  • Media files are no longer mixed into the All tab by default; they stay in their own Images, Videos, Documents and Audio tabs, which always show every match.
  • When nothing ticked matches but another tab has results, the All tab links to them (for example “No pages found. See 12 images”) instead of showing an empty page.
  • All Tab Results also apply to Smart 404 suggestions and to your theme’s search page. Your previous Max Results Per Type values carry over.
  • Predictive Search can use the results page’s All tab settings (“Same as results page”, on by default) or its own types, order and maximums.
  • Removed the Result Grouping checkbox; Display by group replaces it.

  • Search Embeds (SERP → Search Embeds): create named shortcodes that limit search to pages, posts, products (optional WooCommerce categories), and/or media types that match your crawl settings (Images, PDFs, Documents, videos, audio, embeds). Custom name, shortcode ID, placeholder, and button label; paste into pages, posts, or builders via [searchus_search scope=”your-id”].
  • Scoped results page: embeds send visitors to SearchUs results with clear “search is limited to…” context and matching tabs/filters for that scope (products-only, media-only, etc.).

short_description: Site search for WordPress and WooCommerce — live AJAX predictive search, ranked results, product filters, Buy Now and Smart 404 recovery.
description:
Replace WordPress’s default search with a powerful site search plugin for WordPress and WooCommerce. SearchUs helps visitors quickly find pages, posts, WooCommerce products, images, videos, PDFs, documents, audio, and other media with fast, relevance-ranked results.

SearchUs delivers a better search experience with Predictive Search as visitors type, customizable results, search intent, synonyms, Smart 404 recovery, and flexible search pages. WooCommerce shoppers can filter products, select variations, and buy from search results—helping them find what they need faster with fewer clicks.

Key Features

Predictive Search (live AJAX search as you type)
Results and word suggestions load live in a dropdown as visitors type, without reloading the page—in your theme’s header search, search icons, Search Embeds, and on the results page. Results are grouped into All, Images, and Shopping tabs; products show their image, price, and an Add to Cart or Buy Now button so shoppers can buy without leaving the page. Word suggestions come from your own index and can include popular searches from other visitors, with your own blocked words and a built-in offensive-word filter. A whole typing session counts as one search, suggesting words never counts, and pressing Enter or “See all results” continues to the full results page without counting twice. On the results page itself, the results update in place when visitors pause after a finished word (no dropdown covering them; each update counts as one search, like pressing Enter), and every dropdown offers “Search for …” so visitors always see how to run what they typed. Works with the keyboard and screen readers, and is off until you turn it on under SERP → Predictive Search.

Better WordPress Search
Replace WordPress’s built-in search with fast, relevance-ranked site search across pages, posts, WooCommerce products, images, videos, PDFs, documents, audio, and other indexed content. Show results on a dedicated search page with tabs such as All, Products, Images, Videos, Documents, and Audio; choose list or grid layouts while keeping your site’s header and footer.

WooCommerce Search Built for Shopping
Turn product search into a shopping experience. Index your catalog, let customers filter by category, price, brand, color, size, and other attributes, and understand natural-language searches like “under $100.” Shoppers can select color, size, and other options on variable products and use Buy Now to cart or checkout without opening the product page first. Map shopper language (for example “XXL” or “sneakers”) to real variation options and intent synonyms so the right products rank and preselect. Optional AI Assist can draft those synonym and variation-alias maps for you.

Scoped Search Embeds
Place search boxes anywhere with a shortcode and choose exactly what visitors can search—products, pages, posts, images, videos, documents, audio, selected categories, or your entire site. Ideal for shop pages, landing pages, and page builders.

Search Analytics & Content Gaps
See what visitors are searching for—including queries that return zero results—so you can improve your site instead of guessing. Spot missing products or pages to create, decide which synonym maps to add, and focus ranking and content work where shoppers actually look. Analytics are on by default, stay on your WordPress site and can be turned off any time.

Search Intent & Synonyms
Understand what visitors mean—not just what they type. Built-in intent and synonym matching help connect searches like “lead gen” with content about “lead generation.”

“Did You Mean?” Suggestions
Reduce failed searches by suggesting better terms when no matching results are found.

Fully Customizable Search Ranking
Control how results are ranked by adjusting the importance of titles, headings, content, URLs, media, products, pages, posts, and more. Promote your most important content to the top of search results.

Automatic Search Indexing
Keep your search index up to date by automatically detecting content changes, crawling your sitemap, or performing a full site scan.

Promote Important Content
Feature announcements, products, promotions, or key pages by inserting promoted results into search results.

Secure & Reliable
Protect your search experience with settings locking, plan-tier rate protection, and automated bot filtering to reduce abusive or junk search traffic before it consumes your usage.

Built to Scale
Whether your site has dozens of pages or hundreds of thousands of products, SearchUs scales with your content while keeping WordPress search fast, organized, and easy to use.

Smart 404 Recovery
Recover visitors before they leave by replacing dead-end 404 pages with relevant pages, posts, products, or media based on the requested URL.

Options

Use the SearchUs search results page, or keep your theme’s default WordPress search template while benefiting from SearchUs indexing and relevance ranking.

Choose which post types, products, and media types to index. Configure layouts, ranking, excerpts, results per page, Buy Now destination, excluded URLs, excluded page sections, and more from one settings area.

Requires PHP 7.4 or later.

After license activation, SearchUs securely communicates with the FunnelWon service for indexing, search queries, licensing, and plan usage. Free plans include a “Site Search by SearchUs.io” attribution link where applicable. Paid plans can remove attribution based on license level. SearchUs does not include third-party advertising or behavioral tracking.

External services

This plugin connects to FunnelWon SearchUs (hosted API and account dashboard at https://searchus.io). Use of the service is subject to our Terms and Privacy (links below).

When data is sent

  • License activation / validation – When you enter or refresh an API key (and on periodic checks the plugin performs).
  • Indexing – When you run a full reindex, delta/index push, or auto-crawl sends content to build or update the remote index.
  • Visitor search – After activation, each real visitor search counts toward the monthly search allowance (unless blocked locally as junk; see below). The service ranks a search when this site does not already have that result saved. A repeat search can be answered from the saved result on the site and still counts.
  • Predictive Search (if turned on) – While a visitor types, the text typed so far is sent after a short pause to show preview results, with a random typing-session ID so the whole session counts as one search. The ID lives only in the open page (no cookie) and is not linked to the visitor. Word suggestions come from a word list the site downloads from the service after each index update; suggesting words sends nothing.
  • Usage and configuration – When the admin loads usage, reindex eligibility, or optional cloud settings backup/sync features you use.
  • Attribution check (free plans) – On free plans, the SearchUs service may load your site’s public search page to confirm the SearchUs attribution is shown.

What is sent (summary)

  • Site URL, API key, plugin version, site identifier, and technical headers needed for authentication and plan routing.
  • Content and metadata you enable for indexing (titles, body areas, headings, product fields, media alt text, filenames, etc.).
  • Visitor search query text, including text typed into Predictive Search (not used for third-party advertising).
  • Aggregated usage for quotas (e.g. query counts, indexed URL counts, reindex allowance).

What stays on your server

  • SearchUs analytics (on by default, can be turned off) is stored in your WordPress database only.
  • Query guard (core/query-guard.php) evaluates queries locally and does not send obvious bot/scanner probes to the API or third parties. Searches from crawlers, monitors and scripts (recognised by their user agent) are not sent or counted either.
  • A search result cache (transients) may store a recent result on the site for speed. A later search for the same text can use that saved result. It still counts as a visitor search. The cache is not shared with advertisers.

Legal

  • Terms of Service: https://searchus.io/tos/
  • Privacy Policy: https://searchus.io/privacy/

For more detail, see the Privacy section below and the in-plugin FAQ.

Privacy

Licensing and API

When the plugin contacts FunnelWon’s (SearchUs) services—for license validation, indexing, search results, or configuration sync—it may send your site URL, API key (if you have entered one), plugin version, and other technical data needed to operate the service. Your site URL is used among other things to apply your plan and allowed environments (for example production, staging, and development URLs permitted under your license). After you complete license activation, indexing sends the content and metadata described in the plugin and settings (e.g. pages, posts, products). Each visitor search counts toward the monthly search allowance. Query text is sent when the site does not already have that result saved; a repeat answered from the saved result still counts. Before activation, those flows are not used for front-end ?s= requests.

Support (information you choose to share)

If you contact support, we may ask you to share diagnostic details so we can reproduce issues and spot conflicts—for example your hosting provider or environment, active WordPress theme (name and version), and list of active plugins, often by pasting Tools → Site Health → Info from your admin. You decide what to send; we use it only to troubleshoot (including cache and plugin conflicts) and improve compatibility. Unless a future feature clearly discloses it and asks for consent, the plugin does not automatically upload your theme or full plugin list to us solely for support.

What the plugin sends automatically (no separate ad or marketing profile)

  • Site identity and licensing: your site URL (and any staging/dev URLs your license allows), API key if you enter one, plugin version, and related technical fields so we can validate the license, apply plan limits, and route API requests.
  • Indexing: text and metadata from the content types you enable (e.g. titles, excerpts, body areas, headings, product fields, image alt text, file names)—only what is needed to build and update the search index.
  • Search: each visitor search counts toward the plan’s monthly search allowance once license activation is complete. The service ranks the search when the site does not already have that result saved. A repeat can be answered from the saved result on the site and still counts. Until an API key is stored after activation, front-end ?s= search uses WordPress’s built-in search and is not sent to SearchUs. Queries are not used for third-party advertising.
  • In-plugin analytics (on by default, can be turned off in the Analytics tab): aggregated search and click counts stored on your WordPress site in its database. No cookies are used and nothing personal is stored. This data is not sent to FunnelWon; it stays on your server and is used for the Analytics tab and popular search suggestions (both can be turned off).

What we do not do

  • We do not sell your site URL, license details, index payloads, search queries, or support diagnostics to third parties for advertising or to build ad profiles.
  • The plugin does not load third-party advertising or behavioral-tracking scripts for FunnelWon’s benefit.
  • We do not automatically upload your theme name, plugin list, or Site Health dump—only what you choose to send if you contact support.

Personal data (PII) in plain language

SearchUs is not designed to collect visitor identities for marketing. However, search queries can contain anything a visitor types, and indexed content may include names, emails, or other data you published on the site—those flows are part of normal search and indexing, not a separate “PII harvesting” feature. If you are a data controller for your site’s visitors, you should describe SearchUs in your privacy policy (and comply with applicable law). FunnelWon’s own handling of data received through the service is described in our policies below.

Terms of Service and Privacy Policy

Use of the hosted SearchUs service is governed by our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy on the SearchSaaS dashboard site:

  • Terms of Service: https://searchus.io/tos/
  • Privacy Policy: https://searchus.io/privacy/

For retention, security, legal bases, subprocessors, and other details, see the Privacy Policy link above. That policy governs FunnelWon / SearchUs as the service provider; your site still needs its own policy where required. The Privacy Policy is also published at https://funnelwon.com/privacy/ for convenience.

Third-party libraries

The plugin bundles Driver.js (https://github.com/kamranahmedse/driver.js) under the MIT License for the in-admin setup walkthrough. Source is included under admin/vendor/driver/.

upgrade_notice.3.1.3: Theme compatibility improvements and a WordPress search fallback.
upgrade_notice.3.1.2: Improved protection against bot and automated traffic adding to search usage, and predictive search now counts up to 8 previews within 60 seconds as one search.
upgrade_notice.3.1.0: The results-page search box now updates results as visitors type (each update counts as one search). No reindex required.
upgrade_notice.3.0.0: Adds Predictive Search: live AJAX search that shows suggestions and results in a dropdown as visitors type, without reloading the page. Off until you turn it on under SERP → Predictive Search. No reindex required.
upgrade_notice.2.0.12: After creating an account in the plugin, enter the 6-digit email code on that screen to verify. No reindex required.
upgrade_notice.2.0.11: Search Embeds can now limit results by category, tag, and other taxonomies — not just post type. Run a full reindex after updating.
upgrade_notice.2.0.10: Blog post, page, and product multipliers now change result order. After updating, save Ranking → Multipliers (only if you change a value). No reindex required.
upgrade_notice.2.0.9: Declares Tested up to WordPress 7.1 so the Plugins screen no longer shows “not tested with your current version.”
upgrade_notice.2.0.8: Dashboard and attribution links now use searchus.io.
upgrade_notice.2.0.7: Improved phrase synonyms for clearer intent matching on multi-word searches.
upgrade_notice.2.0.6: Restore “SearchUs – Site Search for WordPress and WooCommerce.”
upgrade_notice.2.0.4: Shows the plan-cap reindex summary with Crawl Inclusion guidance before the admin page reloads.
upgrade_notice.2.0.3: Improves large-site reindex handling and clearly reports API plan-cap results with Crawl inclusion guidance.
upgrade_notice.2.0.2: Fixes mobile search result grids so product and media tiles fit the screen without sideways scrolling.
upgrade_notice.2.0.1: Shortens the WordPress admin sidebar menu to “SearchUs.”
upgrade_notice.2.0.0: Major ecommerce and embed release: Search Embeds shortcodes, product filter drawer, natural-language price filters, variation pickers & option aliases.
upgrade_notice.1.0.4: SERP Background paints solid white by default; use Transparent / match theme if you want the theme background to show through.
upgrade_notice.1.0.3: Updates Shopping tab tile styling to match Images and other grid SERP layouts.
upgrade_notice.1.0.1: Fixes license activation on Kinsta and other staging preview hosts, and on sites with plain permalinks. Update, then re-save your license in SearchUs settings if activation failed before.
upgrade_notice.1.0.0: First public release. Complete free or paid license activation in SearchUs settings, then run a full reindex so indexing and visitor search use the API.

screenshots.caption: Included content: choose post types and media for the index, plus URL/DOM exclusions and crawl-related options.
Search experience (SERP): search page layout, redirect, results per page, list or tile view, excerpts, and visitor-facing search UI.
Synonyms and intent detection: map phrases and intents so informal queries still match the right content.
Auto-crawl and reindex logs: see scheduled and automatic index updates after content changes.
Results page, list view: stacked results with titles, URLs, snippets, and thumbnails where available.
Results page, tile view: grid layout for a more visual browse of results.
Results page, Images tab: image-only results from indexed media (alt text, titles, filenames help relevance).
Results, image pop-up: larger preview of an image result without leaving search.
Results page, Videos tab: video results from indexed video content.
Results, video pop-up: in-place playback for a video result.
Results page, shopping tab: product-focused results when products are indexed (e.g. WooCommerce), respecting your ranking settings.
